runtime.note: Source is shipped directly in dist; no bundler/package installation required. Static import/HTML/CSS references and referenced local assets verified; actual behavior requires browser acceptance.

withdrawals.rule: 仅显式启用。每个回合开始的缓释、持续伤害等既有结算之后、预备和先攻之前，若仍有敌人且存活正式队员不多于设定人数，整队自动撤退并结束本次远征。只数本次六名正式队员，不数召唤物；不取消上回合已排队行动，不保证不会在检查前全员倒下。未清场不算通关，不发通关/首通加成、不记普通攻略证明；只领取已通过房间的原有收益，已支付资源不退，本次余料不永久保存。检查时机和整队规则是项目暂定改编。

finiteCases.limits: 36 predeclared finite route/threshold/seed inputs plus actual normal earned departures7/8/9 after prior failures. No seed search, no hypothetical avoided harm or guaranteed survival/win attribution. Threshold is optional and not a numeric difficulty nerf.
